## This document contains preliminary EDA for data story on French scoail movement's involment of women participants.


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyverse)

data_raw <- read.csv(
  "data/db_hiscod_csv_v1_en.csv",
  sep = ";",
  header = TRUE
)

```
### Make a copy of the data
```{r}
data_copy <- data_raw |>
  separate_wider_delim(
    cols = 1,
    delim = ";",
    names = strsplit(names(data_raw)[1], ";")[[1]]
  )
```

### Take a look of the data
```{r}
head(data_copy)
tail(data_copy)
slice(data_copy)
glimpse(data_copy)
colnames(data_copy)
```

### The column I am interested in are id, year, contry_name, women_participation. So I am slecting the three column to check the dataset. 
```{r}
data_select <- 
data_copy |> 
  select(id, country_name, year, women_participation)
```

### For contry, I only want to include France; for year i want to range from 1700 to 1900
```{r}
france_data <-data_select |>
    filter(
    country_name == "France",
    year >= 1700,
    year <= 1900
  )
head(france_data)
```

### Take a look of the fittlered data
```{r}
head(france_data)
tail(france_data)
slice(france_data)
glimpse(france_data)
colnames(france_data)
```

### Check the distribution of the variable 
###women's participation
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(france_data, aes(x = women_participation)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of the variables Women's Participation in French Social Conflicts",
    x = "Women's participation",
    y = "Number of events"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

###year
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(france_data, aes(x = year)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of the variables Year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of events"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Summarize the dataset by year
```{r}
yearly_summary <- france_data |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    total_conflicts = n(),
    women_yes = sum(women_participation == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    women_no = sum(women_participation == "No", na.rm = TRUE),
    women_unknown = sum(women_participation == "Unknown", na.rm = TRUE),
    percentage_women = (women_yes / total_conflicts) * 100
  )

yearly_summary
```
